reading.signal: Shorts get PASSIVE views (4831 total) but ZERO active engagement: 0 external comments, 0 replies, ~12 likes. Views are feed/impression-driven, not community-driven. Per sanity band, treat near-zero interaction like low reaction -> fix hook/topic/title, do NOT build game features.
reading.top_hook: Founding-myth / origin framing wins on views: 고조선(Gojoseon) 1403 = ~2x next best. Heroic-individual (이순신 653 / 광개토대왕 646) cluster next. But none converted views into comments.
reading.weak: Lowest views are newest uploads (Myeongnyang 13, Jang Yeong-sil 21) — partly recency; recheck after 7-day maturation. Bigger weakness: no comment-to-action loop — owner asks 'which hero next?' in pinned comments but gets 0 audience replies.
reading.conversion_gap: External engagement 0% and 0 education-material requests. itch.io click/play/purchase unknown (private). The real unproven step is view -> itch.io click -> play; high views with 0 comments suggests weak CTA pull-through.
reading.education_request_audit: Read all 13 comments 2026-06-23: 0 are from external viewers; 0 request educational/classroom materials; 0 purchase intent. DB-4 education-request bar still unmet.
reading.next: 1) Hook iteration leaning into founding-myth angle (best view driver). 2) Strengthen first-comment/CTA to provoke replies. 3) Obtain itch.io + Studio private analytics (KDE-DATA-001) to measure view->play conversion that public API cannot see.
